module: "Get Vehicle Bounds" node (category `repeat_instant`, tags telemetry/bounds/corner). Gives the corners of the vehicle's oriented bounding box (`getSpawnWorldOOBB`): outputs `corner_FR`, `corner_FL`, `corner_BR`, `corner_BL`, `center` (vec3). Input pin: `vehId` (default 0, otherwise player).
notes: `center` is the average of the OOBB corners at indices 0, 3, 4, 7.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: Writes the four corners and the center to the outputs.
